quest.title: Amidst Stormy Judgment
quest.description: Komore Teahouse is empty, silent as the grave but for Taroumaru's uneasy barking. You have a bad feeling about this...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x925, Primogem x30, Mora x44000, Inazuma Shrine of Depths Key x1, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

talks.objective: Go to Komore Teahouse the following day

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How strange... It's never this quiet here.

dialogues.speaker: Taroumaru
dialogues.text: Woof, woof... woof!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thoma's playing his ventriloquist game again, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thoma... Thoma...

dialogues.speaker: Taroumaru
dialogues.text: Woof! Woof! ...Woof!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, you can come out now... Paimon's seen you already...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, not a peep... Ugh, so where the heck is he, then?

dialogues.speaker: Taroumaru
dialogues.text: Woof, woof, woof! Woof!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What's got Taroumaru so worked up today? He's always such a good boy...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Hello, have either of you seen Thoma?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, we thought he'd be with you! Why, has something happened?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Then it's as I feared... On the way here, I heard that Thoma had been taken away by the Tenryou Commission.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I wasn't certain whether it was true, so I came right here. The fact that he hasn't arrived here as we arranged suggests that it is true.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: The Raiden Shogun is holding a Vision Hunt Ceremony at the Statue of the Omnipresent God today, to mark the 100th Vision seized under the decree.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: And the 100th Vision bearer in question... the one who will have their Vision seized, I fear... is Thoma.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hold up a second... So the ceremony that Thoma said the Tenryou Commission were busy preparing for... that was this Vision Hunt Ceremony? And he was the target all along?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: ...I believe so. The shogun and the Tenryou Commission see the ceremony as a milestone. With the 100th Vision, they wish to mark the success of the Vision Hunt Decree to date.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: ...This cannot happen. I must go and rescue him!

dialogues.speaker: Taroumaru
dialogues.text: Woof, woof! Woof!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Stay calm.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But you are the Shirasagi Himegimi.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! Like it or not, you represent the whole Yashiro Commission. So if you go and pull a stunt like that, you're basically declaring you and the Raiden Shogun are enemies now, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And by doing it so publicly, you might be implicating a lot of other people from the Yashiro Commission, too...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: There is no other option... I must act with haste — the ceremony is about to begin. I will not abandon Thoma like this.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: He is my friend! To think that not long ago, we were... all eating hotpot together...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: He is my friend, too. I will save him.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: But...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You said it yourself. No time to delay.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: ...Okay, I'll... wait here for your return. Get back safely.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Ayaka. A friend's life is on the line — we ain't about to mess this up!

talks.objective: Go to the Vision Hunt Ceremony

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Please be careful...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Inazuma's not such a bad place, Paimon's having a pretty good time! But... we should probably go and see about the "next operation" that Thoma and Ayaka were talking about, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: As usual, it's the first stop, Komore Teahouse. Are you ready to head over?

dialogues.speaker: Watanabe
dialogues.text: Ugh! I failed again... The disgrace of it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Tenryou Commission...

dialogues.speaker: Watanabe
dialogues.text: As you can see, the times have changed. The Tenryou Commission is currently redeploying its defenses all across Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Watanabe
dialogues.text: Though we're not as efficient or brave as Madam Kujou Sara makes us out to be, we spare no effort in protecting Inazuma and stopping these monsters from ravaging the land...

dialogues.speaker: Watanabe
dialogues.text: I knew we could count on Madam Kujou Sara! The reinforcements she sent are all seasoned veterans!

dialogues.speaker: Watanabe
dialogues.text: With experienced fighters on hand, no amount of monsters can breach this pass!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About your wounds...

dialogues.speaker: Watanabe
dialogues.text: Ha, nothing more than a scratch! Tenryou Commission samurai don't back down in critical moments like these!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What a valiant spirit! No wonder people are starting to feel more at ease!

dialogues.speaker: Watanabe
dialogues.text: The situation seems to be stabilizing... Madam Kujou Sara won't feel pressured to take action.

dialogues.speaker: Watanabe
dialogues.text: No need to rush. We'll launch a general offensive as soon as Madam Kujou Sara finishes with her business in the city, and take down this Domain in one go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We should hurry, they seem pretty amped up...

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Those who seek ultimate attainment, can find it in practices of this Mystic Onmyou Chamber.

dialogues.speaker: Shiki Taishou
dialogues.text: Of course, rushing straight for the strongest opponent may set you back. Know yourself, and proceed in accordance with your abilities.
